name: Datadog Error Tracking
summary: Datadog Error Tracking groups errors from browser, mobile, backend and log sources into issues. Standalone errors cost $25 a month on annual billing for the first 50,000, then $0.25 per 1,000 up to 100,000. Errors that come with APM traces or RUM events cost nothing extra.

facts.text: Datadog computes a fingerprint from attributes such as error type, message or stack trace, and errors with the same fingerprint share one issue.
Monitors can alert on high error volume or on new issues.
An issue resolves itself after 14 days without new errors, or sooner when a newer version no longer reports it and version tags are set.
Errors collected as part of APM traces and RUM events are included at no extra cost, while standalone errors are billed.

plans.name: Error Tracking, first 50,000 errors
plans.notes: Billed annually; $30 on month-to-month billing and $36 on demand

plans.name: Error Tracking, 50,000 to 100,000 errors
plans.notes: Annual rate; $0.30 month-to-month and $0.38 on demand. Rates fall to $0.10 per 1,000 above 20 million errors

hiddenCosts: Error Tracking is priced separately from APM, RUM and Logs, which most teams also need for the traces behind an error.
On-demand billing is about 44% higher than the annual rate for the first 50,000 errors.
